verdict.rationale: Dialpad offers AI voice and digital agents, so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The pack never shows Dialpad acting as an MCP client. The only MCP mention describes 'connecting Dialpad with AI tools and agents', which reads as Dialpad exposing itself to external agents (server role). That is a different story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
